support.metaDescription: Why Vibes Paid Off is free, where donations go, and how projects are ranked without manual curation.

faq.freeQ: How is this free? Are there ads?
faq.freeA: No ads, no paid features. Vibes Paid Off exists so Indonesian makers have a place to show their work along with how they built it. The site runs on free tiers, so the only required cost is the domain.
faq.moneyA: First, the domain. If the site grows and the database starts filling up, donations pay for a bigger server. Every cost is listed openly on this page.

local.body: Pay with QRIS, e-wallets, or a local bank transfer.

global.body: Card or PayPal, in your own currency.

support.makerTip: Are you a maker? Add your own tip link to your profile so people who like your work can treat you directly. <link>Set it up in your dashboard</link>

later.label: Later, if it takes off
later.body: Upgrade the database to Supabase Pro, about US$25 a month, once it nears the free limit.

picking.question: Who chooses “This week's pick”?
picking.answer: Nobody. Admins have no button to feature a project. Every ranking on this site comes from the same formula, and the formula is written out right here.
picking.votesBody: A vote counts when the account is at least 3 days (72 hours) old and the project is live. Makers can't vote for their own projects. Votes from newer accounts still show in the Worth it count; they join the ranking once the account is old enough.
picking.repliersBody: Each person who replies (not the maker, account at least 3 days old) counts once per project, however many replies they write. They weigh half a vote, because a lively chat is a sign the project is interesting too.
picking.popularBody: Scores from the last 7 days, always up to date. Ties go to more eligible votes, then to the project published first. Each maker appears at most once, so nobody takes every spot.
picking.pickBody: Computed automatically every Monday at 00:05 WIB from the previous Monday–Sunday, then frozen for the week. To qualify: a score of at least {min}, at least one screenshot, a link that isn't archived, never picked before, and a maker who wasn't picked in the last 4 weeks. If nobody qualifies, the home page shows the newest project instead. If the winner gets hidden after reports, the runner-up moves up automatically.
picking.worthItBody: The order on Explore and tool pages uses all-time eligible votes. Ties go to the more recently published project.
picking.exampleIntro: The pick for the week of {week}, scored on {range}:
picking.exampleHidden: A project that is no longer public
picking.exampleNone: The pick for the week of {week} (scored on {range}) had no candidate reaching a score of {min}, so the home page shows the newest project.
picking.exampleSample: Say a project has 4 eligible votes and 3 eligible repliers: its score is 4 + 0.5 × 3 = 5.5. That clears the threshold of {min}, so it can be picked if it scores highest that week.

communityRules.metaDescription: What's allowed on Vibes Paid Off, what isn't, and how moderation works.
communityRules.intro: Vibes Paid Off is a place to show off your work and share how you built it. The rules are few, and they apply to everyone, admins included.

share.title: What to share
share.own: Projects you made yourself, or were directly involved in making.
share.ai: Built with help from AI. It doesn't have to be 100% AI, but tell us which parts it helped with.
share.honest: The prompts and sessions you write must be honest. Tidy them up, don't make them up.
share.live: The live link has to open. If you've shut the project down, archive it from your dashboard.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.illegal: Adult content, gambling, scams, phishing, malware, or anything illegal.
forbidden.spam: Spam, repeated promotion, or affiliate links unrelated to the project.
forbidden.privacy: Other people's personal data, API keys, or tokens in screenshots, prompts, and replies. Redact before uploading.
forbidden.harassment: Harassment, hate speech, or belittling others.
forbidden.impersonation: Pretending to be someone else, or passing off other people's work as yours.

replies.title: When replying
replies.respect: Criticism is fine, belittling is not. Talk about the work, not the person.
replies.useful: If you give advice, make it something people can try right away.
replies.promo: Don't use replies to promote your own project.

moderation.title: How moderation works
moderation.review: Every maker's first project is checked by an admin, usually within 48 hours. Once approved, you become a trusted maker and your next projects go live right away.
moderation.rejected: If it's rejected, the reason shows up in your dashboard. You can fix the project and send it again.
moderation.reports: Anyone logged in can report a project or a reply. Once 3 different accounts report it, it's hidden automatically until an admin reviews it.
moderation.actions: Admins can restore, hide, or remove content, and revoke trusted maker status after repeated violations.
moderation.ranking: Admins can't pick or boost projects. Rankings come from the same formula for everyone. <link>See how we pick</link>

communityRules.closing: These rules may be updated as the community grows.
